b: Get ready for Spring 2027 with The Poetry School!
We are pleased to announce our courses for Spring 2027 will be available to book very soon!
However, booking will work a little differently to normal this time as we are currently in the process of creating a brand-new website and digital learning platform.

There’s currently a lot of work underway to ensure everything is ready for when our Spring courses start; this means that for next term our courses will be available to book exclusively through our newsletter.
This means you will only be able to secure your place by clicking the links sent in our newsletter and the programme won’t be viewable on this website.
Please read all the information below to ensure you have everything you need ahead of our Spring launch.
You will be able to book a course with us directly through our newsletter, which will be sent out on Monday 23 November.
If you are not signed up to our newsletter, please click the ‘subscribe’ button below:

If you are not sure whether you are signed up, check that you received our most recent newsletter, which was sent out on 27 October. If you didn’t receive this, you may need to sign up again. Please also make sure our emails come to your main inbox by marking us as a ‘safe sender’ (in case they land in your junk folder and get missed!).
Why will there be a brand new website?

The current website was built in 2015 and we were limited by the technology available to us at that time. As the years went by, our courses have developed, our programme has expanded, technology has advanced, and the efficacy of the platform fell behind. This led to a number of students and tutors experiencing difficulties with our courses (both with booking and participating). Over the years, we’ve tried a number of ways to keep the current website operating and provided lots of advice and guides to our users; however, we have now reached the point where we are unable to manage that site any further. Our new website is going to fix the issues and provide a better experience from booking to participating in our courses. You can find out more information on the new website and what that means for the current website here.

We know there will be a lot of questions and we will do our best to help and support you with any queries you may have. As the website hasn’t officially launched yet, there are some questions we may be unable to answer immediately, but our team will do our best to answer some of the initial queries you may have before booking a Spring course with us:
Do I need to create a new Login to book my course(s)?

Yes, you will need to create a login on the new site to be able to purchase a course with us. This should only take a minute or two and you will be able to add more details to your account profile after purchasing your course. You can sign up with the same email you are using on our current site.
Will you still be running your usual courses?
Yes, our Online, Zoom, Seminars, 1-2-1’s and In-Person courses will all still run.

Our Online courses will now take place on a new learning platform, Moodle, which is designed to be much simpler to navigate and use. The basic format (i.e. 5 fortnightly assignments, posted into a forum-style area for tutor and peer feedback) will remain the same. However, this will come with lots of quality of life improvements, such as no longer having to use hashtags in your uploads, course completion tracking, and a much smoother learning experience. You’ll receive more information and guidance on using the site once you have booked your place on a course.
Will the same Financial Support options be available on the new website?

Yes, if you currently have a concession code you should be able to use this when booking a course through the new website. You will also still be able to apply for a bursary and the form will be made available on the new website, or can be emailed to you upon request.
If I have a Gift Voucher, will I be able to use it on the new website?
Yes, your Gift Voucher will still be valid if it has not yet been redeemed (although please remember they are valid for only 1 year after purchase, so do check this).
Will payment plans still be available?
Yes, more information will be available on this soon.
How will I receive booking confirmation and course reminders?
You should receive a payment receipt once your order has gone through. We will be able to provide more information on course reminders soon.
If I attended an Advanced course in Autumn, will I have priority booking for Spring?
Yes. If you attended an Advanced course in Autumn, you can book the same course for Spring without reapplying and all current students will receive a link to book directly.

The current application process for Advanced courses still applies for new students: you will need to email 3 samples of your poetry to [email protected] before booking your place. Please do not book a spot before applying. You will be invited to secure your place if your application is accepted.
Will the same tutors be teaching the courses?
All our 3-term tutors will be back and we will have a mix of previous and new tutors running Online and Short Zoom courses, just like with previous terms.
How will the new courses work?

Our Zoom courses will work in the same way as before, however, where you may have previously used a CAMPUS Group or GDrive for sharing poems and accessing handouts, you will now do this on our new learning platform. We will be able to provide more information on how this new works soon.
Will courses only be available to book through the newsletter going forward?
No, once the website is fully up and running you will be able to book directly for future terms (although you will also have the option to book through our newsletter if you’re signed up!).
Do I have to stay subscribed to the newsletter?

Once you have signed up and booked your courses for Spring term you are welcome to unsubscribe if you choose – however we would encourage you not to, as our newsletter is the best way to stay up to date with all our latest news and offers, some of which are exclusive to our subscribers.
If you have a query regarding the use of our current website, head to this page.
Whilst we don’t have all the answers ourselves yet, if you have a query that’s relevant to our Spring term launch that hasn’t been answered above, please submit it here.

Please note, we won’t be able to respond to these queries directly, but this will provide us with an idea of what information to include when our Spring courses launch and, if it is relevant, we will make sure to address it and update this page accordingly.

We know that change can be overwhelming and we want to do our best to support our students and tutors through this transition as much as possible. However, please do remember we are a small team and this site will be brand new to us too, meaning we might not have all the answers immediately, so please be patient and kind in any communications with us – thank you!
